description: With Variance Chart, you can create professional column or bar charts that visualize the difference between two measures—such as actual vs. target—as clearly separated, color‑coded areas based on IBCS® (International Business Communication Standards). Key features: Two chart types available: column or bar Optional lollipop chart to display percentage values Drill functionality with visible hierarchy groups Full support for negative values Compliance with selected IBCS® requirements (e.g., striped columns) Customizable indicator colors, including reverse indicator mode Individually formattable value types, e.g., to highlight forecast periods Additional invisible measure for alternative sorting Extensive formatting options, such as column width, margins, colors, and label styling (font family, size, color) Alternative licensing option for environments that do not support default per‑user licensing (e.g., Embedded and Report Server). Licenses available upon request (info@relevantvisuals.com)
keywords: Professional variance charts with IBCS‑compliant design
Flexible formatting and advanced sorting for Power BI
Column and bar charts with customizable value types
